name: Basolateral amygdala glutamatergic principal neuron
morphology_summary: Pyramidal-like projection neurons with spiny dendrites; comprise ~70-80% (often cited as ~75%) of BLA neurons. Morphology varies: small cells with restricted dendritic fields confined to limited sensory terminal zones, alongside larger neurons with more extensive dendritic fields.
ephys_summary: Excitatory projection neurons utilizing glutamate as neurotransmitter; not described in detail in the report.
subtypes_noted: Heterogeneity in dendritic field extent (small vs large neurons); also referred to as pyramidal, spiny, or class I neurons.

name: Basolateral amygdala parvalbumin basket cell
morphology_summary: Basket cells expressing parvalbumin; estimated at ~17-20% of GABAergic cells in lateral and basal nuclei. Among the clearest parallels between BLA and neocortical inhibitory organization.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory interneurons; not detailed in report (BLA interneurons described as electrophysiologically heterogeneous overall).
subtypes_noted: PV+/CB+ population includes both basket cells and axo-axonic (chandelier) cells.

name: Basolateral amygdala axo-axonic (chandelier) cell
morphology_summary: Chandelier-like axo-axonic cells targeting axon initial segments; estimated at ~5.5-6% of GABAergic cells in LA and BA.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory interneurons; ephys not specified in the report.
subtypes_noted: Part of broader PV+ interneuron population in BLA.

name: Basolateral amygdala somatostatin interneuron
morphology_summary: Dendrite-targeting inhibitory cells expressing somatostatin; ~10-16% of GABAergic neurons in LA and BA. SOM+/CB+ co-expression noted in older immunolabeling studies.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory interneurons; one cited study (Unal et al., 2020) characterizes low-threshold spiking interneurons performing feedback inhibition in lateral amygdala.
subtypes_noted: Closely related GABAergic projection neurons expressing both somatostatin and neuronal nitric oxide synthase (~5.5-8% of GABAergic cells) are listed separately as projection rather than local interneurons.

name: Basolateral amygdala cholecystokinin basket cell
morphology_summary: CCK-expressing basket cells; ~7-9% of GABAergic cells in LA and BA. Older descriptions also note large multipolar CCK+ neurons, often CB+.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory interneurons; ephys not specified in the report.
subtypes_noted: Large multipolar CCK+/CB+ neurons (McDonald et al., 2012) and CCK basket cells (Vereczki et al., 2021) may represent overlapping or distinct populations.

name: Basolateral amygdala VIP/calretinin interneuron-selective interneuron
morphology_summary: Small bipolar and bitufted interneurons with extensive co-localization of calretinin, CCK, and VIP. Interneuron-selective interneurons (targeting other interneurons); estimated at ~29-38% of GABAergic neurons in LA/BA, the largest single GABAergic fraction.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory interneurons; ephys not specified in the report.
subtypes_noted: VIP and/or calretinin co-expression; grouped as a single class but acknowledged as molecularly mixed.

name: Basolateral amygdala NPY neurogliaform cell
morphology_summary: Neurogliaform cells containing NPY; ~14-15% of GABAergic neurons in lateral and basal nuclei.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory interneurons; ephys not described in detail in the report.
subtypes_noted: No further subtypes noted within BLA neurogliaform class.

name: Basolateral amygdala GABAergic projection neuron (SST/nNOS)
morphology_summary: Long-range GABAergic projection neurons (not local interneurons) co-expressing somatostatin and neuronal nitric oxide synthase; estimated at ~5.5-8% of BLA GABAergic cells.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory projection neurons; ephys not specified.
subtypes_noted: Distinct from local SOM dendrite-targeting interneurons by virtue of projection axon and nNOS co-expression.

name: Central amygdala GABAergic projection neuron
morphology_summary: Spiny GABAergic projection neurons; the central nucleus contains predominantly/exclusively GABAergic principal neurons; comparison to striatum is repeatedly drawn. Central amygdala serves as a major amygdaloid output nucleus.
ephys_summary: Inhibitory output neurons; ephys not described in detail in the report.
subtypes_noted: CeA further splits into medial (CeM), lateral (CeL), and central (CeC) sections.

name: Medial amygdala GABAergic principal neuron
morphology_summary: Predominantly GABAergic subpallial-derived principal population; medial amygdala described as a mosaic of GABAergic subpallial cells from pallidal, preoptic, hypothalamic, and prethalamic eminence origins, complemented by extrinsic glutamatergic input cell types.
subtypes_noted: Multiple lineage-defined subpopulations: pallidal-, preoptic-, hypothalamic-, and prethalamic-eminence-derived cells; TOH-domain (Otp+) and SPV core (Sim1+) lineages distribute distinctly across medial and central extended amygdala.

name: Medial amygdala Lhx9+ ventral pallial-derived glutamatergic neuron
morphology_summary: Minor subpopulation of Lhx9+ neurons of ventral pallial origin within the medial amygdala; part of the extrinsic glutamatergic complement that joins the predominantly GABAergic mosaic.
subtypes_noted: One of several extrinsic glutamatergic populations (ventral pallium, SPV, EmT-derived) contributing to medial/extended amygdala.

name: Amygdala intercalated cell
morphology_summary: Small clusters of densely packed GABAergic neurons positioned between major amygdaloid nuclei; treated as a distinct amygdalar population rather than just local interneurons. Often grouped with otherwise unclassified amygdaloid nuclei.
subtypes_noted: No subtypes detailed in this report.

name: Hippocampal pyramidal neuron
morphology_summary: Principal excitatory pyramidal neurons arranged in a single main cellular layer (pyramidal cell layer) across CA1-CA4. Dominant excitatory class of the hippocampal CA fields.
subtypes_noted: CA-subfield-specific distinctions implied (CA1, CA2, CA3, CA4) but no further marker-defined subtypes given.

name: Dentate gyrus granule cell
morphology_summary: Excitatory granule cells forming the principal cell type of the dentate gyrus; report cites Bcl-2 immunolabeling of a few layers of intensely labeled granule cells in juvenile monkeys, with increased numbers in adult and aged monkeys.

name: Subicular projection neuron
morphology_summary: Subiculum contains principal excitatory projection neurons; mentioned only at the broad-class level in this report.

name: Paralaminar/ventral amygdala immature excitatory neuron
morphology_summary: Persistent immature-appearing neurons co-expressing DCX, PSA-NCAM, Bcl-2, beta-tubulin-III and NeuN; extend as a stream from the lateral ventricle SVZ into the paralaminar nucleus and adjacent medial temporal cortical areas. In humans, develop during adolescence (Sorrells et al., 2019); CGE-linked progenitor markers (SP8+, COUP-TFII+, few NKX2.1+) are co-detected in dense progenitor fields.
subtypes_noted: Spans a continuum from progenitor-like (Ki-67+ vimentin+ nestin+) to postmitotic immature neurons (DCX+ Bcl-2+ NeuN+); also includes a clustered Bcl-2+ population in piriform cortex.

name: Basal amygdala fear neuron
morphology_summary: Functionally defined ensemble within the basal amygdala active during fear states; not defined by markers or morphology in the report.
subtypes_noted: Paired with extinction neurons as opposing functional populations within the same nucleus.

name: Basal amygdala extinction neuron
morphology_summary: Functionally defined ensemble within the basal amygdala active during extinction of conditioned fear; not defined by markers or morphology in the report.
subtypes_noted: Counterpart to fear neurons in the same nucleus.

name: Medial temporal lobe concept cell
morphology_summary: Human MTL neurons functionally selective for specific concepts; recorded in hippocampus, amygdala, and entorhinal cortex. Defined by encoding properties rather than molecular markers.
ephys_summary: Single-unit recordings show concept-selective firing in humans.
subtypes_noted: Paired in the report with parahippocampal location-selective neurons as a distinct functional class.
